definitions.explanation: A mountain covered with snow; also a large heaped pile of snow, such as one left after clearing it. Read ゆきやま in everyday use; せつざん is used in mountaineering.

examples.japanese: {冬|ふゆ}の{雪山|ゆきやま}は{美|うつく}しいが{危険|きけん}だ。
examples.english: Snowy mountains in winter are beautiful but dangerous.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもたちは、{除雪|じょせつ}でできた{雪山|ゆきやま}の{上|うえ}で{遊|あそ}んでいる。
examples.english: The children are playing on top of the snow pile left by the snow clearing.

notes:
Combines {雪|ゆき} (snow) + {山|やま} (mountain). A snow-covered mountain, or a heaped pile of snow. In mountaineering it may be read せつざん.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {雪山|ゆきやま}に{登|のぼ}る: to climb a snowy mountain
- {雪山|ゆきやま}{登山|とざん}: snow-mountain climbing
- {雪山|ゆきやま}{遭難|そうなん}: getting stranded on a snowy mountain

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {雪原|せつげん}: snowfield — a wide expanse of flat, snow-covered land
- {雪景色|ゆきげしき}: snowy scenery — the view of a snow-covered landscape
